EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Bermuda High Pressure offshore delivered heat and humidity to Massachusetts.  Heat indices in Eastern Massachusetts climbed into the lower 100s on the 2nd, but not high enough for an Excessive Heat Warning. Heat Index values climbed into the 90s on the 3rd. This tropical weather allowed a few strong thunderstorms over Western Massachusetts both days, with reports of flooding from downpours on the 3rd.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: At 4:12 PM EST heavy rain in Greenfield caused flooding of several basements on Franklin Street. At 4:33 PM EST Scout Road was flooded and impassable with some basement flooding.  At 4:36 EST PM Sanderson Road near Kennemetal and the Medical Center was completely flooded. At 4:46 PM EST Adams Road was flooded and impassable. At 5:06 PM EST Green Street in Greenfield had significant basement flooding.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: An atmospheric trough moved over Massachusetts on the 4th, tapping high amounts of moisture in the air to cause heavy showers that resulted in flooding.  Up to 6.5 inches of rain fell on Cape Cod, and 1 to 3 inches across the rest of Massachusetts. A few thunderstorms also moved across the state, causing wind damage.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: At 9:29 AM EST, several cars were reported trapped in flood waters on Sutton Avenue in Oxford.
